commands.label: Billboard Breakout
commands.desc: Product crosses beyond a billboard frame with convincing depth.
commands.instruction: Build a realistic billboard/display and let the exact product or related visual element cross beyond its frame with correct occlusion, shadow and perspective.

commands.label: Anamorphic 3D Display
commands.desc: Forced-perspective DOOH illusion from one intended viewpoint.
commands.instruction: Create a static anamorphic display concept designed for one ideal viewing angle so the product and scene appear to extend beyond the screen volume.

commands.label: Fake OOH / FOOH
commands.desc: Impossible public installation blended into a real place.
commands.instruction: Create a photoreal fake-OOH concept where the exact product or brand-relevant element becomes an impossible but believable public installation.

commands.label: Building Facade Takeover
commands.desc: Building skin becomes a branded spatial intervention.
commands.instruction: Transform a believable facade using wrapping, protrusion, cut-through, sculptural objects or branded spatial elements while preserving architectural realism.

commands.label: Building Transformation
commands.desc: Architecture opens, folds or shifts to reveal product.
commands.instruction: Make walls, roof or facade open, fold, slide or separate in a structurally coherent way to reveal the exact product or branded experience.

commands.label: Giant Inflatable Takeover
commands.desc: Oversized soft-body brand form occupies a public space.
commands.instruction: Create a custom inflatable based on the product, logo or brand-relevant form with believable seams, pressure, tethering, deformation and scale.

commands.label: Cloth / Fabric Wrap
commands.desc: Large branded textile wraps or unfurls across architecture.
commands.instruction: Use cloth to wrap, drape, unfurl or grip a structure with believable folds, tension, gravity and wind. Do not imply a real installation or partnership.

commands.label: Storefront Takeover
commands.desc: Shop window or storefront becomes a surreal 3D campaign.
commands.instruction: Transform a storefront into a bold CGI idea using depth, product scale, window breakouts or spatial merchandising while keeping real street reflections and contact.

commands.label: Mall / Atrium Activation
commands.desc: Large indoor retail space becomes an immersive installation.
commands.instruction: Use escalators, balconies, shoppers and atrium architecture to stage an experiential CGI activation around the exact product.

commands.label: Airport Takeover
commands.desc: Terminal, baggage or travel systems become the campaign mechanism.
commands.instruction: Use terminal architecture, baggage belts, gates, jet bridges or luggage systems as the spatial idea. Never imply airport or airline sponsorship unless supplied.

commands.label: Transit / Station Takeover
commands.desc: Metro, platform or bus-shelter architecture becomes the canvas.
commands.instruction: Integrate the exact product into a station, platform, bus shelter or transit corridor with believable geometry and without implying official sponsorship.

commands.label: Vehicle Carry
commands.desc: Truck, bus or vehicle transports an oversized product.
commands.instruction: Stage a vehicle supporting, transporting or interacting with an oversized exact product using believable suspension, weight, road contact and scale.

commands.label: Claw / Crane Reveal
commands.desc: Mechanical crane or claw lifts or reveals product.
commands.instruction: Use a crane, claw or lifting rig to hold, lower or reveal the exact product. Show cables, hooks, tension, industrial physics and scale convincingly.

commands.label: Conveyor / Delivery System
commands.desc: Product moves through an imaginative logistics mechanism.
commands.instruction: Use a conveyor, baggage belt, package sorter, chute or rail as a branded spatial story. Do not invent operational/logistics claims.

commands.label: Giant Gift Box Reveal
commands.desc: Oversized package opens to reveal product or experience.
commands.instruction: Create a giant gift-box or package reveal integrated into architecture or public space with believable hinges, paper/box structure, shadows and scale.

commands.label: Giant Vending Machine
commands.desc: Public-space vending mechanism turns launch into an event.
commands.instruction: Create an oversized or surreal vending-machine concept where the exact product is selected, dispensed or revealed. Do not invent prices or offers.

commands.label: Portal Exit
commands.desc: Product emerges from a dimensional portal in real space.
commands.instruction: Composite a believable portal into a real public setting and have the exact product or brand elements emerge with correct occlusion, lighting and depth.

commands.label: Rooftop Installation
commands.desc: Oversized product or sculpture dominates a believable rooftop.
commands.instruction: Integrate a monumental exact product or brand sculpture with realistic rooftop support, wind exposure, skyline scale and shadows.

commands.label: Landmark Interaction
commands.desc: Product interacts with a supplied landmark or public structure.
commands.instruction: Create a respectful CGI interaction with a landmark explicitly supplied or appropriate to the current location brief. Do not imply endorsement or permission.

commands.label: Giant Banner Unroll
commands.desc: Massive banner unfurls across a facade or public structure.
commands.instruction: Create a static key moment of a giant banner unrolling, dropping or wrapping with believable fabric weight, wind, anchors and shadows. Use only supplied or non-factual copy.
